purpose: Isolated S33 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Effect present/absent/not_assessed gates applicability with reviewed severity; AIMS item responses are measurement context only pending the complete reviewed source; no diagnosis from unreviewed total and no treatment threshold.

fields.definition: Tardive dyskinesia effect status for this follow-up encounter: present, absent or unresolved assessment requiring clinician review of movement pattern, persistence, exposure, onset and alternative explanations with AIMS measurement context when the complete reviewed source is available.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/tardive-dyskinesia-criteria.md — Diagnostic features (movement pattern, persistence, exposure, onset) and Differential diagnosis; STATEMENT-14 Implementation (evaluation, AIMS/DISCUS, no score threshold for intervention)
fields.operationalization: Present requires clinician-recorded involuntary choreiform/at athetoid/stereotyped movements with persistence, exposure and onset review plus alternative explanations considered; Absent requires assessment finding no such persistence; Unresolved/not_assessed/unknown means assessment incomplete or conflicting and pauses. AIMS item responses are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; no diagnosis is inferred from an unreviewed AIMS total and Schooler-Kane research thresholds are never treatment thresholds. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether tardive dyskinesia is associated with antipsychotic exposure in this follow-up context, after alternative explanations are considered.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (tardive syndromes caused by sustained antipsychotic exposure; assessment for other contributors including history, examination and indicated studies)
fields.operationalization: Established requires documented dopamine-blocker exposure with onset during exposure or within withdrawal windows and alternative contributors reviewed; NotEstablished requires assessment finding no such association or an alternative explanation. Unknown pauses. Exposure agents and windows only; no dose/route/frequency. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician-reviewed motor severity for this encounter, separate from disabling impact; never inferred from an unreviewed AIMS total.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (no specific AIMS score threshold suggests need for intervention; ranges correspond with mild, moderate and severe; same total varies)
fields.operationalization: Mild/ModerateOrSevere records the clinician-reviewed motor severity with examination and window attribution. No AIMS total band or numeric cutoff is set here; Schooler-Kane research thresholds are not severity bands. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Disabling impact of tardive dyskinesia for this encounter, separate from motor severity, including functioning, health status and quality of life.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (impact on functioning, health status including dentition, and quality of life) and Balancing Benefits (moderate to severe or disabling)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician records disabling impact with functional attribution; Absent means review found none. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Reason for reviewing mild tardive dyskinesia, such as patient preference, associated impairment or psychosocial functioning.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (mild tardive dyskinesia review on preference, impairment or psychosocial functioning)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician records a mild-case review reason with attribution; Absent means no such reason recorded. Unknown pauses. This is a review reason, never a treatment order. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Temporal relationship between dyskinesia and antipsychotic dose reduction, including withdrawal-emergent course requiring longitudinal reassessment.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (withdrawal-emergent dyskinesia with dose reduction; assess longitudinal course for months; persistence despite reduction)
fields.operationalization: Present means movements began or increased with dose reduction with window attribution; Absent means review found no such link. Brief withdrawal movements require longitudinal reassessment; unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician-determined urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs at this encounter; displayed independently of estimation latency.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (life-threatening constant movement, gagging or choking rapid suppression context) and Balancing Harms
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies an urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs during current assessment; Absent means urgent assessment completed without identified concern. Banner renders from saved inputs independently of estimation latency and is never a model-computed risk percentage. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Candidate-specific VMAT2 safety context for review: incomplete review, concerns identified or reviewed with no concern identified; current label context only, no prescribing rule copied.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Table 11 and Implementation (hepatic/renal, CYP2D6/CYP3A4, QTc, depression/suicidal ideas monitoring; consult current product labeling)
fields.operationalization: Incomplete means safety review not yet completed; ConcernsIdentified means clinician records a safety concern with factor attribution; ReviewedNoConcernIdentified means review completed without identified concern. Table 11 details are background only and are not copied as activation metadata. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Patient preference about VMAT2 review for shared decision review, used only as defined and collected.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Patient Preferences (most moderate to severe wish diminution; willingness when well tolerated) and Balancing Benefits/Harms
fields.operationalization: WillingToDiscuss means patient is willing to discuss VMAT2 review after shared discussion; Declines means documented decline with alternatives discussion; Undecided means preference not yet clarified. Missing discussion remains Undecided/unknown, never Declines. Operational meaning requires owner review. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Current anticholinergic use represented for review, including worsening and reconciliation context.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-14.md — Implementation (anticholinergics do not improve and may worsen tardive dyskinesia; high-dose dystonia use is not a dyskinesia rule)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician records current anticholinergic use with agent/window attribution; Absent means review found none. No dose/route/frequency collected. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
